task: authoritative server-side step-safety + budget binding + safe rescheduling

contract_mapping.keep_closed: packages/contracts/session_failure_containment.py (classify_recovery, loss causes, terminal kinds, recovery statuses/reasons, generation/epoch/attempt fence, RECOVERY_ATTEMPT_MAX)
contract_mapping.step_safety_registry: closed, provider-independent per-action {idempotent, result_verifiable} registry co-located with the existing domain action contract (domain_call_admission.ACTIONS); ordinary contract extension

authoritative_source.step_idempotency_and_result_verifiabilit: BYQ domain contract, never the client and never the model prompt; safe only when (1) the step is in the closed BYQ domain action set with a persisted idempotency_key and request_hash/input_hash, (2) an exact receipt reconciliation surface exists, and (3) it is not a write/order/publish/paid/irreversible action outside the registry; otherwise unknown
authoritative_source.budget: services/backend/app/research_continuation.py research_tasks.continuation_permission + continuation_budget (authoritative); adapter carrier and DSH guard journal are bounded mirrors
authoritative_source.receipt: services/backend/app/research_receipts.py and the existing domain idempotency lookup plus adapter reconcile_prompt
authoritative_source.identity: existing Backend auth session and owner-scoped Product catalog

budget_binding.task_bound_run: bind the lost run to the exact persisted (reservation_id, event_key, input_sha256); derive budget_available from remaining=token_limit-charged_tokens, max_turns, expires_at, grant_version/revocation; exhausted/expired/revoked -> blocked; missing/ambiguous -> None -> paused
budget_binding.arbitrary_chat_turn: no authoritative reservation; budget_available stays None -> paused

safe_rescheduling.bounded: at most RECOVERY_ATTEMPT_MAX=3 per lost run, additionally bounded by reservation max_turns/expires_at/turn_timeout_seconds and DSH guard call/token bounds; must fit remaining authoritative reservation else budget_exhausted
safe_rescheduling.idempotent_exactly_one: new continuation reservation under deterministic recovery event key recovery-v1:<sha256(original_event_key + interrupted_run_id)>; the existing Backend ledger enforces one row per event_key inside its transaction (advisory lock / FOR UPDATE), so a concurrent duplicate creates zero extra reservations; domain writes retain original idempotency keys and reconcile request_hash instead of replaying
safe_rescheduling.receipt_first: success receipt -> settled (never replay); hash/identity conflict -> blocked; absent/unqueryable receipt with non-idempotent/unknown step -> paused
safe_rescheduling.auditable: loss recorded in the fenced adapter containment ledger; reschedule recorded in the Backend continuation ledger with run_id/charged_tokens/settlement_sha256 lineage; Gateway projection exposes the decision; no second store and no /tmp authority
safe_rescheduling.fenced: stale executor epoch, stale/duplicate generation, late settlement and terminal reopen fail closed (FencedWrite)

failure_semantics.ordinary_failed_cancelled_discarded_clos: keep ordinary semantics; interrupted projected only from fenced containment matching the same session/trace and exact run
failure_semantics.unreadable_or_corrupt_containment_or_rec: treated as unavailable -> paused, never proof of absence or success

next_slice_acceptance_criteria: closed step-safety registry derived from the existing domain action contract plus receipt surfaces; every unlisted step is unknown

classify_recovery invoked with real authoritative values (identity from existing Backend session/catalog; budget from continuation_budget; success receipt from existing reconciliation; step safety from the registry) with byte-for-byte fail-closed fallback to paused on any read failure

exactly-one bounded reschedule under a deterministic recovery-v1: event key, only within the original authoritative reservation and at most RECOVERY_ATTEMPT_MAX; concurrent duplicates create zero extra reservations; no second store
receipt-first: success receipt -> settled (no prompt); conflict -> blocked; non-idempotent/unknown -> paused
fenced: stale epoch/generation/attempt and terminal reopen fail closed
fail-able observer plus negative controls that a result-trusting gate would misreport, with machine-readable evidence
no new persistence authority, trust subject, cross-Plane call, production selector change, deploy, release/tag, Phase 100 resume or D15 superseding assessment

adr_decision.rationale: ordinary closed-contract extension over already-authorized BYQ authorities; budget binding reuses the existing Backend continuation_budget ledger; receipt reconciliation reuses existing research_receipts / prompt-receipt surfaces; the Gateway->Backend _catalog_request internal seam already exists and is already used for task continuation and receipt reconciliation; no new trust subject, persistence authority, production topology or external write permission
decision_points: step-safety declaration is an ordinary extension of the existing domain_call_admission contract
receipt authority stays services/backend/app/research_receipts.py and existing domain idempotency lookups
identity authority stays the existing Backend auth session plus owner-scoped Product catalog
no new persistence, no new principal, no new cross-Plane surface
future_triggers_requiring_a_proposed_adr: a new trust subject or principal
a change to the ADR-0084 gate classification
